body: I tried using NuRec to train and generate USDZ, but the generated data is missing a lot—there is no clipgt, no mesh, and no map.

comments.body: I forwarded your question to the internal team that manages NuRec to see if that capability exists. The AlpaSim team is also a consumer of that data and not responsible for generating or maintaining those artifacts.

From the NuRec team:
```
I think this proposed workflow could work well if im understanding correctly

since they have their own collected data, i'd use this skill to convert to ncore v4 - https://github.com/NVIDIA/nurec-skills/blob/main/skills/ncore/SKILL.md#ncore-v4-data-conversion

then i'd refer to https://github.com/NVIDIA/nurec-skills/blob/main/skills/nre/SKILL.md to do the reconstruction
```

Hope this helps! Resolving for now, but feel free to reopen here or on that other repo

title: If I want to run AlpaSim using my own collected data, how can I convert my data into a USDZ file usable by AlpaSim?
